14/S0.subgoal: Summarize the previous discussion on VR hardware and outline the topics to be covered in this lecture.

14/S1.subgoal: Describe the different methods used for full-body tracking in VR systems.

14/S2.subgoal: Explain how sound or speech tracking functions as a non-hand input method in VR.

14/S3.subgoal: Describe the role and range of processing elements used in a VR system.

14/S4.subgoal: Analyze how Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and CPUs contribute to the performance of a VR system.

14/S5.subgoal: Determine the memory requirements and summarize the core components of a VR processing system.

14/S6.subgoal: Identify the main categories of output devices used to render a VR experience.

14/S7.subgoal: Differentiate between the three broad types of visual displays utilized in VR systems.

14/S8.subgoal: Explain how specialized audio output enhances immersion in a VR setup.

14/S9.subgoal: Describe the different types and classifications of haptic rendering systems.

14/S10.subgoal: Contrast active and passive motion platforms and explain their effect on physical movement.

14/S11.subgoal: Explain how treadmills function as an output device to simulate physical movement.

14/S12.subgoal: Summarize the main hardware components (input, computer, output) discussed in the lecture.
